task.title: Close the ephemeral-port race in the serve and watcher tests
task.description: Eleven tests in internal/cli (run_test.go around lines 1242, 1316, 1422, 1540, 1582, 1654, 1721, 1854, 1954; serve_routes_test.go ~263; watcher_test.go ~523) find a free port by binding 127.0.0.1:0, closing the probe listener, and handing the address string to serve or the watcher to bind again. Between the close and the rebind another parallel test's probe can be handed the same port, which would fail the rebind with EADDRINUSE. The package now runs its tests in parallel and three runs showed no flake, but the window is real. Close it by letting the code under test accept an already-open net.Listener (or a listener-providing hook) instead of an address, so the probe listener is the one the server uses; a retry on EADDRINUSE only narrows the window. Found by the review of the parallel-tests change.
